verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: T1: games rows are restricted to final == True; only game types 2 and 3 occur, so every row is regular or playoff.
T1 sg: o_r_pre is taken from the opponent's regular row of the same game; cell counts nc may be 0 (value then equals L_x); the row's own date is excluded from all league/cell sums.
T1 tp: 'win and not beyond' etc. evaluated on the 0/1 win and beyond flags; n counts the team's earlier regular rows of the same season.
T1 pc: ratios computed for every row (regular and playoff) from HOME rows dated strictly before d; NaN if the playoff or regular set is empty or regular mean <= 0.

T1 sc: series key (season, min, max) pools every playoff meeting of the two teams in a season (incl. any round-robin/qualifying games) into one series, as literally stated; F is evaluated with the row-date ph; sc_goal_diff_pre is filled even when ph is NaN; sc_p_home_hist_pre is ph(d) for the row's date (NaN when fewer than 50 prior playoff home rows).

T1 rs: moneypuck rows matched on (game_id, team_id); the 40-row window is over the team's earlier regular rows regardless of NaN; weighted mean = sum(w*v)/sum(w) over non-NaN values; rs_xgf60/xga60 are NaN when k < 5 (NaN mean propagates); lg uses xgf60 for both columns.
T1 gsp: Poisson pmf truncated at i, j = 0..15 without renormalisation.
T2: goals, shots and goalie rows are attributed to the home/away row by their is_home flag (not team_id).
T2 sf/tmin: tmin taken over all goal rows of the game (any period type).

T2 goalie_start: window rows whose starter is undefined count in the window size (share denominator) but cannot be top; top is undefined if no window row has a starter; y = 0 when top is defined but the row's own starter is undefined; rest days = calendar-day difference; b2b = 0 for a team's first row.
T2 gs_p_top: q(d,b), sy and sn use only rows with defined y; sn/sy are grouped by (team, b2b).
T2 gm: n counts starts of the top goalie for any team dated strictly before d; q_c computed over all starts dated before d.
T2 shr: NaN whenever E(X;60,10) is NaN (fewer than 10 earlier rows), even when n = 0, per the NaN-propagation rule; same for os_* with E(.;40,5).
T2 ot/period/os league ratios: ratio of sums over all universe rows dated before d; NaN when denominator is 0.
T3: chronological order per player = (date, game_id); team_gp = index of the game among the team_id's distinct universe (players-table) games of that season ordered by date.
T3 pts_ev/pts_pp: counted from all goals rows of the same game with that strength (assist ids matched after casting to integer).
T3 ixg: moneypuck xGoal (float32) cast to float64 before summing; 'game has no rows' tested on nhl_game_id over all shot rows (any state).
T3 pv/pw: 0 when the player has no rows in season-1 / season-2; they are sums over the whole prior season for the player (any team).
T3 wsum-based ratios (ptoi, gfpg) are NaN when the denominator is 0 (e.g. the player's first row), making ix_exp_pre / ipp_exp_pts_pre NaN there.
T3 projection: prior = pv(c)/pv(gpf) if pv(gpf) >= 20 else lgpos (lgpos NaN on the first date -> NaN outputs); avail = 1 when team_gp == 0.
T3 gph_prior_missed: weighted mean over qualifying k of max(82 - g_k, 0) with weights 0.5 / 0.3.
T3 gph_missed10: previous min(10,k) games of the row's team_id in that season; a game counts as played only if the player has a universe row for that same team_id with toi_s > 0.
T3 joc: window sums computed as differences of a global cumulative sum (exact for integers/halves).
CSV: NaN written as empty cells, floats written with pandas default repr (full precision); T1 sorted by (date, game_id, team), T2 likewise, T3 by (date, game_id, player_id).
